name: Content Ingestion
description: External content ingestion system — event-driven, adapter-based pipeline for ingesting content from WordPress (and future sources) into ApplicationOS CMS.
author: Ikabud Kernel Team

events.description: Emitted when normalized WordPress content is ready for CMS ingestion.
Emitted after the media pipeline completes for a WordPress import run.
Emitted after CMS ingestion succeeds or fails for a single content item.
Emitted when the bridge state transitions (active/read-only/archived/disabled).

bridge_state.label: Bridge State
bridge_state.description: Controls whether content ingestion is allowed. active=open; read-only=page renders only; archived/disabled=fully locked.

source_adapter.label: Source Platform
source_adapter.description: The CMS platform being ingested from. Determines available sync tools and normalization pipeline. Only WordPress is available in Phase 1.

source_site_url.label: Source Site URL
source_site_url.description: The base URL of the site being migrated (e.g. https://myblog.com). Used for SSRF allowlisting and media URL rewriting.

source_name.label: Source Name
source_name.description: A human-readable label for this WordPress source (e.g. "Marketing Blog"). Used to identify the source in the ingestion log.

bridge_api_token.label: Bridge API Token
bridge_api_token.description: Auto-generated bearer token used by the WP companion plugin to authenticate ingestion requests. Rotate via the Bridge Settings page.

settings_fields.label: Source Platform
settings_fields.description: The CMS platform you are migrating content from.

settings_fields.label: Enable Content Ingestion
settings_fields.description: Enable CMS admin navigation and ingestion API for this bridge.

settings_fields.label: WordPress Site URL
settings_fields.description: Base URL of the source WordPress site (e.g. https://myblog.com). Used for SSRF allowlisting during media fetch and for URL rewriting in migrated content.

settings_fields.label: Source Name
settings_fields.description: Human-readable label for this WordPress source. Appears in the ingestion log and bridge dashboard.
